==Problem==

How many whole numbers lie in the interval between <imath>\frac{5}{3}</imath> and <imath>2\pi</imath>?

<imath>\text{(A)}\ 2 \qquad \text{(B)}\ 3 \qquad \text{(C)}\ 4 \qquad \text{(D)}\ 5 \qquad \text{(E)}\ \text{infinitely many}</imath>

==Solution==

Note that <imath>1 < \frac{5}{3} < 2</imath> while <imath>6 < 2\pi < 7</imath>.  Therefore, the interval from <imath>\frac{5}{3}</imath> to <imath>2\pi</imath> contains <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(D)}\ 5}</imath> whole numbers: <imath>2</imath>, <imath>3</imath>, <imath>4</imath>, <imath>5</imath>, and <imath>6</imath>.
